touch_target: minimum48dp effective; at360dp width this is approx126 source-coordinate px. Expand Control hit areas independently of original raster scale. Do not stretch art just to meet touch target.
collision: Resolve adjacent hit areas without overlap, including records link/next button and split action buttons. Verify at360dp width.
disabled: disable input plus whole-art brightness; labels cannot be only disabled indication
focus: keyboard/controller focus same existing gold hue; no new palette
data: all QA numbers/examples not runtime defaults. All same-store energy; dynamic page count; same-attempt result pairs or explicitly label separate bests
modality: pause game per existing logic; capture underlay input, close/back routes verified; language changes never reset board
accessibility: current/completed/locked text supplements colors; saturated palette remains existing values
engine_status: contract only, not measured on real Android
